note: Raw inputs of the ABIT models. status: documented = URL taken from the project's download logs / scripts / notes; verify = no URL documented in the project, the provider's landing page is given; project product = made by an earlier stage of this project.

sources.name: 2017/18 Regional Travel Survey (Baltimore and Washington regions), household travel survey, weekday travel day
sources.provider: Baltimore Metropolitan Council (BMC) and the National Capital Region Transportation Planning Board (TPB) at the Metropolitan Washington Council of Governments (MWCOG)
sources.url: https://www.baltometro.org/ and https://www.mwcog.org/ (verify: no download page is documented in the project; the data are released on request)
sources.how: Request the 2017/18 Regional Travel Survey public-use files from BMC (Baltimore region) or MWCOG/TPB (Washington region). The project used one flat file in which every trip row carries its household and person fields (household, person, trip and vehicle tables joined): RTS_raw_flat_data.csv, with the codebook RTS_codebook_data_dictionary.xlsx (sheets Household, Person, Trip, Vehicle). The two cleaned files rts_trips_clean.csv (163,290 trips, deduplicated) and rts_tours.csv (57,627 home-based tours) were made by 01_clean_rts.py of the tour-based MITO project; that script is not on this machine, so these two files are shipped and cannot be rebuilt here. Survey weights: wthhfin, wtperfin, wttrdfin. If you receive separate household / person / trip / vehicle tables instead, join them on household_id, person_id (persno) and tripid to the flat layout of the codebook.
sources.place_in: 00_shared_data/raw/rts_2017_18 (the project's copies are provided in 00_shared_data/rts_2017_18/raw as .csv.gz)
sources.notes: Status: provided (copies). Licence: survey data of the MPOs; do not redistribute without their agreement.

sources.name: Maryland Statewide Transportation Model (MSTM) 2016 skims, 1,588 SMZ/RMZ zones
sources.provider: Maryland Department of Transportation (MDOT SHA), via the project's ABIT Maryland set-up (ABIT/input/mito_los/skims)
sources.url: https://www.roads.maryland.gov/ (verify: MSTM data are provided by MDOT on request; no download page is documented)
sources.how: Obtain the MSTM 2016 skims in OMX format (matrix mat1, lookups origins / destinations): traveltime_auto.omx (AM-peak car time, min), distance_auto.omx (car distance, m), bus_tt.omx (bus time, min; 1000 = no path, 5 intrazonal), rail_tt00.omx (rail time, min; 0 = no rail path). convert_mstm_skims.py turns them into the csv.gz files the models read.
sources.notes: Status: the converted csv.gz are provided in 00_shared_data/skims/abit_base_2016 (bus_tt and rail_tt00 there are the 2016 MSTM transit skims; the location models read the 2024 door-to-door transit skims instead).

sources.name: MSTM zone system: SMZ/RMZ polygons, zone table, ABIT zone attributes
sources.provider: MDOT (MSTM), via ABIT/input/mito_los/Zonal and 2_silo/input/zoneSystem.csv; ABIT/input/maryland/zone_attributes.csv (ABIT Maryland set-up)
sources.url: https://www.roads.maryland.gov/ (verify: provided with the MSTM)
sources.how: Zone polygons SMZ_RMZ_02152011inMSTM_EPSG26918.shp (+ .dbf .shx .prj; field id / SMZRMZ, 1,588 zones), zoneSystem.csv (ZoneId, COUNTYFIPS, ...), zone_attributes.csv (id, centroid x/y EPSG:26985, countyfips, region types, bbsr, area_km2; built for ABIT from mstm_26985.shp and zoneSystem.csv, see 3_abit/coef_respec/PROVENANCE.md, script not in the project).
sources.notes: zone_attributes.csv is provided in 00_shared_data/zones; the shapefile is needed only to rebuild tract_zone.csv, the tract-to-zone overlay, the TAZ crosswalks and the transit skims.

sources.provider: this project: VAE synthetic population (1_vae/export_silo_base.py -> 1_vae/vae_outputs/06_silo_input) + 2_silo/input_build/build_microdata.py (vacant jobs and dwellings) + 2_silo/schools/assign_students.py (school records, schools_2016.csv)

sources.how: Copy pp_2016.csv, dd_2016.csv, hh_2016.csv, jj_2016.csv (2_silo/input/microData, versions of 2026-10-22) and schools_2016.csv (2_silo/input) of the project. Used for: zone population (persons per zone, survey_population.zone_population), jobs by zone and type (RET / OFF / other; build_zone_tables.py --jobs-from-raw), school enrolment by zone (occupancy of schools_2016.csv).

Rebuilding the population itself is the VAE stage (Updated VAE pipeline; inputs ACS PUMS 2012-2016 5-year, LODES 2016, JOLTS), outside this package.
